QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] Dark World Tree: Middle Tier 1
QuestInfo.0: According to Alchetto, the demons are beyond reason. Give them an end worthy of their previous valor and purify the World Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the corrupted demon soldiers from the middle tier of the World Tree and gather 20 demon swords and 20 demon axes.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the demons. The World Tree feels a little less dark.
